facts.conditions: The source allows 2.2 uH but recommends 3.3 uH for full output current at low input voltages without defining a universal low-VIN threshold here. Larger L reduces ripple but slows transient response. PSM entry depends on ripple from the actual operating point; not a universal load threshold or continuous-current entitlement.

facts.conditions: Most-application guidance, not a guaranteed minimum. Place input bypass at VIN/PGND; larger values can reduce input ripple. DC bias lowers effective ceramic capacitance; package size, voltage rating and dielectric affect the gap from nominal. Actual bias/tolerance/temperature behavior of a proposed capacitor is not established by its label.
